$comment: The source of sf-input's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/input (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how. The folder was `inputs`; it takes the tag's name (§3, §21, §16 item 16).

appearance.summary: How the field looks: a bordered box, a filled one, or hidden.

change.summary: The value was committed; the native event bubbles from the inner input, which is its target. It carries no detail.

input.summary: The value changed while typing; the native event bubbles from the inner input, which is its target. It carries no detail.

field-reset.summary: The person pressed the reset back to the inherited value. The event of the trait field-inherit@1: one name for every field of the family, so a form hears them all at once and tells them apart by detail.tag. Fired before the field is emptied and cancellable: preventDefault keeps the value. When it is not prevented the field empties, says so with its ordinary change, shows the inherited value again and takes focus back.

tag.summary: The element that was reset, as a tag name.

value.summary: The field's own value before the reset.

inherited-value.summary: The inherited value it returns to.

name.summary: The form name, empty when the field has none.

relations.name: icon-buttons
$comment: The reset back to an inherited value is an icon button (simai/ui-source#28).

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16): the build does not compile template.html yet, so a second copy of the markup would only drift from the one that draws.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-input for the shim (stands/18-aliases-ci/alias.mjs, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), split / detail-adds (a detail adapter, refused by the shim), attribute-and-property, method, property, manifest-only (the DOM name does not change), host-attribute (no shim), retired.

rows.note: stays a host attribute, read by the base (§3.1, §4.8); no shim
error is a dated alias of invalid; the shim maps the attribute and the property

rows.summary: Legacy name for appearance, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

rows.note: the legacy name of icon-start; icon-start wins when both are given
the legacy name of text-end; text-end wins when both are given

the event of the trait field-inherit@1, declared in component.json as the shared event field-reset; the field sends sf-field-reset and the shim follows it with this dated name, same detail, one cancel
rows.summary: The person pressed the reset back to the inherited value. Fired before the field is emptied and cancellable: preventDefault keeps the value. When it is not prevented the field empties, says so with its ordinary change, shows the inherited value again and takes focus back.

x-summary: A native single-line form control with Framework presentation, validation messaging and optional mask integration.
x-renamed: settings.aria-label: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)
x-decisions: folder and id: inputs -> input (§3, §21). The loader bundle is cl-input; the former bundle name cl-inputs is a dated Loader forward to it (src/core/contracts/smart-rule-forwards.v1.json, until 2026-12-01), not a rule of its own, so the registry counts one Smart component. The registry id follows the folder and the tag: smart.input; smart.inputs is its dated alias in the change journal (path-smart-inputs-to-input, until 2026-12-01).

trait-words: the field-inherit@1 words stay in lang x-trait-words beside the component words, as the sf-switch pilot keeps them; the running words are helpers/inherited-value.js INHERITED_TEXT until the trait has its own folder (Annex A item 13 is open).

trait field-inherit@1: host state data-inherited (§5.3, §20.2) and the trait event sf-field-reset with sf-field:reset as its dated same-detail alias (aliases.json), as the sf-switch pilot; an inherited value never satisfies required (§20.2).
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; no template.html until the build compiles one (a copy nothing draws would drift).
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json (the required e-mail reference) plus the three appearances, icon-start/text-end, invalid with a message, disabled, read-only, inherited and size 2.
css-variables: the six public variables of public-variables.v1.json plus --sf-input-invalid-border-color for the invalid state (§6).
error -> invalid (§17.2), type -> appearance, left-icon -> icon-start, right-text -> text-end: dated setting aliases (aliases.json, until 2026-12-01); the canonical name wins.
form.validity: what the native input reports and the host mirrors -- value-missing, type-mismatch, pattern-mismatch, too-short, too-long -- and custom-error (§17.2).
form: the host is the form control through ElementInternals; the native input (the hidden one too) carries no name (§17.1 item 6); read-only still submits.
minlength and maxlength stay strings as converted (no x-todo raised them; a type change is a major).
version 1.3.0: renamed members behind dated aliases are a minor (§4.10).

version 1.3.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.
version 1.3.2: the first-paint sheet list names the utility sheets its templates draw with (core.runtime 1.0.7 asks for them before the element draws: the style gate).

version 1.3.3: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.4.0: the trait event is declared in component.json as the shared event field-reset (standard 1.3.13 §8: an event a trait brings is named sf-<verb>, with no tag): the element sends sf-field-reset itself and the manifest describes it, with tag in the detail. Before, the registry described only the retired sf-field:reset and no current name, and the new name came from the alias shim alone. The dated sf-field:reset follows with the same detail and one cancel until 2026-12-01.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-input for a single-line text, email, password, search, telephone or URL value that must participate in a native form.
do_not: Do not use Input for multiline text, numeric steppers, selects or date selection
Do not use the hidden presentation for visible interactive controls
Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component

accessibility.focus: Keep visible focus on the active control. After a reset back to the inherited value, focus returns to the control; while the value is inherited, the control carries it as aria-description and the visible marker is aria-hidden.

sf-field:reset.summary: The person pressed the reset back to the inherited value. Fired before the field is emptied and cancellable: preventDefault keeps the value. When it is not prevented the field empties, says so with its ordinary change, shows the inherited value again and takes focus back.

value.description: The field's own value before the reset.

inheritedValue.description: The inherited value it returns to.

name.description: The form name, empty when the field has none.

getInputElement.summary: Returns the inner native input, or null before render.

onInput.summary: Adds a listener for input on the host. Returns the element.

onChange.summary: Adds a listener for change on the host. Returns the element.

onKeyUp.summary: Adds a listener for keyup on the host. Returns the element.

onKeyDown.summary: Adds a listener for keydown on the host. Returns the element.

onFocus.summary: Adds a listener for focusin on the host. Returns the element.

onBlur.summary: Adds a listener for focusout on the host. Returns the element.

resetToInherited.summary: Returns the field to its inherited value, as the reset button does: fires the cancellable sf-field-reset, then empties the own value and focuses the control. Returns whether it was reset (false without an inherited value, without an own value, while disabled or readonly, or when the event was prevented).

aria-label.description: Accessible name for a field rendered without a visible label; it lands on the native input.

inherited-value.description: What the field falls back to while it holds no value of its own -- a default from a parent setting, a brand, a theme. Shown as inherited, in the placeholder's ink with an «inherited» marker, never as the value: the form value stays empty. Once the field holds a value of its own, a reset button returns it here. A number field is sf-input with inputmode numeric or decimal and takes it the same way.

inherited-text.description: The words of the marker shown while the inherited value applies. Unset, it follows the page's language («inherited», «наследуется»).

reset-label.description: The accessible name of the button that returns the field to the inherited value. Unset, it follows the page's language («Reset to inherited», «Сбросить к наследуемому»).
